properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Solutions turned over 2026-09-02 for the cause in `fact:the-gap-replay-warning-exists-because-rehydrate-declines-to-run-when-the-caller-sent-text`.

THE SETTLED PART: `rehydrate_gaps` already resolves a gap by id against a live `detect_gaps()` and replaces the caller's copy wholesale. Its guard runs it ONLY when the caller sent an empty description and evidence. So the server has the authority and declines to use it in exactly the case where the caller's copy can be wrong. proj:chama's mangled title would have been repaired for free.

**THE QUESTION UNDERNEATH, which decides between every option below: is the pass-2 GapCandidate an INPUT the caller may legitimately shape, or an ECHO the server should treat as untrusted transport?** Nothing in the design says. The tool's own prose says "REPLAY EACH GAP OBJECT UNCHANGED", which reads as echo — but the code's behaviour is input.

🛑 **A SECOND, INDEPENDENT REPORTER — dev_storyflow, 2026-08-23, ten days before chama and from a different project.** Same defect, and their diagnosis is sharper because they measured it: *"4 of 5 came back `rephrase_degraded: true` ... Cause, found by diffing my two calls: between the passes I had TRIMMED the gap objects' `description` and `title` for readability. The one gap I passed back byte-identical was the one that worked."*

Two reporters, two different mutilations — one trimmed for readability, one duplicated a fragment by accident — same silent re-key. That is evidence the failure is not carelessness but the shape of the API, which is the argument for A/C over E.

⭐ **AND THEY RULED OUT THE OBVIOUS DIAGNOSIS, which saves the next investigator the trip:** *"The prompt `id`s matched (`9c9eb00f5f1bdcdf` was identical across both of my calls), so id-matching is not the discriminator and I had no signal to reason from."*

**THEY ALSO NAMED A REPAIR NEITHER chama NOR I DID, and it is orthogonal to the input/echo question — worth taking whichever way that lands:** name the REASON on degrade. *"`rephrase_degraded: true, reason: 'gap payload differs from the prepare pass'` vs `'answer empty'` vs `'answer failed validation'`. Those are very different problems and today they look identical."*

⚠️ AND BOTH REPORTERS HIT THE SAME SECOND-ORDER HARM: the degraded question is still RECORDED. Storyflow: *"a session that did not read the flag would have left four jargon questions sitting in `open_questions` under the user's name."* chama's is still there. That is the other decision, `dec:idea-a-recorded-questions-wording-can-be-corrected`.

OPTIONS, none preferred:

· **A — Always rehydrate.** Resolve every gap by id, replace wholesale, delete the guard. Kills the class outright and the ⚠ warning becomes unnecessary. Cost: one `detect_gaps()` per serve pass, already batched to once per call. ⚠️ REAL BEHAVIOUR CHANGE: a gap that has CLOSED since the caller's copy was taken currently gets served; after this it refuses with `gap_is_gone`.

· **B — Rehydrate, fall back to the caller's copy when the id does not resolve.** Kills the mangling class and keeps today's tolerance for closed gaps. ⚠️ Silent: a caller who edited deliberately loses the edit with no signal.

· **C — Verify rather than replace: compare, refuse on mismatch, name the difference.** Turns a silent degradation into a loud refusal, the shape this project prefers elsewhere. ⭐ It also delivers storyflow's "name the reason" ask for free. ⚠️ Costs a round trip and treats every difference as an error.

· **D — Accept `gap_id` as chama asked, and deprecate the object form.** On its own a patch; as a deprecation it is `rule:fix-it-properly-while-it-is-still-cheap` clause two.

· **E — Do nothing; the warning is already there.** ⚠️ Now argued against by two independent projects, one of which read the tool description and trimmed the payload anyway — for readability, which is exactly what a well-behaved agent does with a large object.

⭐ NOT THE SAME AS F-01, checked rather than assumed: `chg:the-replay-contract-is-pinned-by-a-round-trip-not-by-a-field` fixed a budgeted row failing to DESERIALIZE (missing `suggested_depth`), by giving the fields serde defaults and pinning the round trip. That is a different failure on the same handshake, already closed. It does not touch the rehydrate guard. ⚠️ But its ROOT CAUSE is the same family and its repair is the generalisable one — "a stated contract maintained by hand with nothing checking it", pinned by a round-trip test rather than by remembering.
properties.name: SETTLED on Anthony's word 2026-09-02 — the replayed GapCandidate is an ECHO: rehydrate always, delete the guard, and the ⚠ replay warning stops being load-bearing
properties.rationale:
Recorded as an idea rather than repaired directly because the cheapest-looking fix (A, delete the guard) carries a consumer-visible behaviour change that nobody has approved, and because the reporter's own request (D) is the one option that is a patch unless it is paired with a deprecation.

⚠️ The bound on all of this: the guard's current condition is not obviously WRONG — it was written for budgeted replies and does that job correctly. What is missing is a statement of what the second pass's argument is FOR, which would make one of these options obviously right and the rest obviously wrong.
